newsitem.title: FRANCE: TF1, France 3 win January TV share - Mediamat.
newsitem.headline: TF1, France 3 win January TV share - Mediamat.

text.p: French private television station TF1 and public channel France 3 gained audience share in January 1997 compared to December 1996, but the share of public channel France 2 fell, according to monthly figures from Mediamat, the French television audience measurement body.
But TF1's audience share fell in January compared to a year earlier. The survey covered two age groups of television viewers, those four years and older, and those 15 years and older.
